```st
VAR
    SequenceStep : INT := 0;

MotorForward := FALSE;
MotorReverse := FALSE;

    MotorReverse := ReverseButton AND NOT ForwardButton;
    CompletionLight := FALSE;

    MotorReverse := FALSE;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
```
